searchText: Is this for Erigon or Akula/Silkworm? if it's the former why can't you just reuse geth/prysm's? If it's the latter you can use LighHouse's network stack, no need to reinvent the wheel. Already Grandine did this so I assume that it's not hard to strip the p2p layer from LH well, problem is go-etheruem dependency we dont behave well when we have go-ethereum as a dependency There were some efforts from <@646424665572507648> and Terence if I remember correctly to get a lightclient working in Go, Also Raúl might be working on this now, If the idea is to have a light-client integrated in Erigon/Geth to not have to run a CL when not staking I feel like these efforts could be joint and there's no need to develop separate light clients implementations in the same language Well, we have some more plans on Erigon, but sure, if you guys want to help me you are welcome I dont see anything wrong in joining joints per say I am developing it under erigon/cmd/lightclient Started it today for now it is only me and <@458053965423312910> working on it and it is more like an experimental project for now, if you want to make it usable by geth too I am fine I am currently looking for the Goerli network configuration. If anyone got a link to it I would greately appreciate it https://github.com/eth-clients/goerli thank you
